about: St Brannock's as the room checks know it (tools/blender/room_checks). Since G2b the checks read the room's numbers from the builder's manifest and the scene (roomcfg.Facts); this file holds only the failures listed for the owner.

known_fails.why: 120 of the map's 124 walkable tiles can be stood on. (1,1) and (2,1) lie under the sexton's cot (ch.cot, a grey box 1.85 x 0.8 m), which lies east to west along the north wall: north to south it would stand on the confessional at (1,2). The same kind as the bedroom's tiles under its bed. (1,9) and (1,10) lie under the crypt stairs (the visible flight, decision D6), 0.9 m wide against the west wall with a rail on its open sides: a narrower well with no east rail kept them but its open edge was an invisible wall, and any well with a rail leaves too little of the tiles. A piece of the room covering walkable tiles, as the bed does. Listed for the owner (2026-11-22), not yet ruled on.
